title: Hold a locked keeper box flat on the checkout magnet while the other hand swings its lid open, then bag the product
instruction: Free the razor cartridges from the locked keeper: slide its lock end onto the detacher's magnet, hold it flat, open the lid, bag the pack.
context: Cashiers in drug and discount stores free locked products from clear keeper boxes at a counter-mounted magnetic detacher, and the lock opens only while the box lies flat on the magnet. OEWS (May 2024) counts about 707,000 cashiers (706,590; O*NET 41-2011) in health and personal care retailers (152,360) and general merchandise retailers (554,230); its Core tasks include "Establish or identify prices of goods, services, or admission, and tabulate bills, using calculators, cash registers, or optical price scanners" (importance 86), and a locked item cannot be rung up until it is freed. Retail Brew (December 2024, 626 stores) found items locked up in 100% of the drug stores and 88% of the mass-market stores it checked. One hand holds the box's lock end down on the magnet while the other pulls the lid off its catch (an estimated 5 N at the lip, twice the 2.5 N box weight) and swings it open; in the simulation, a one-hand pull tips the box off the magnet and the lock holds.
setup: Station table (wood); cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x forward, y left; heights above the table. Two YAM arms, bases at y +30.5 and -30.5, start in their ready pose. A magnetic detacher (Alpha S3 counter detacher S3MDKEYST, 146 x 44 x 44 mm) is set into the table, its dark face flush with the top and its length along x, with a light 3.2 cm magnet disc centred at (23.5, 0) and a red label near its robot end. A clear keeper box (modelled on the Alpha (Checkpoint Systems) Multi-Use Keeper AVM406BNDL, 201 x 135 x 46 mm outside; here 19 x 11.5 x 5 cm, 250 g: base 190 g, clear lid 60 g) lies flat on the table, its length along x, centred at (32, 3); its lock end, nearest the robot, starts 3 cm left of the magnet. Its clear base tray has a 4 mm floor and 1.6 cm walls; the lock end is a grey ridged lock cap 2.6 cm long, full width and full height. The clear lid covers the rest (16 cm) and is hinged along the far top edge; the lid's top plate overhangs the base on its right side as a 5 mm lip, 3 mm thick, along the lid's whole 16 cm side edge at the lid top (5 cm up), pinched 4 cm from the lock end, 15 cm from the hinge; the maker publishes no lip size, so it is the few-mm edge of a clear lid. The lid starts shut and locked. Inside lies a boxed razor-cartridge pack (10 x 7 x 3 cm, 80 g, printed: blue with an orange band, a logo panel, a window showing four cartridges and a count label), its length along x, centred at (31.6, 3). The bagging area is a 20 x 16 cm mat flush with the table, centred at (28, 21).
scoring: Scored at the end, or once full score has held 1 s (20 steps); a pack set in the bagging area less than 1 s before the end scores 0.5; tiers read the current state. 1.0: pack at rest (under 0.05 m/s), any side down (lowest corner within 3 mm of the table), every corner over the 20 x 16 cm bagging area, centre outside the keeper. 0.5: lid open 70 degrees or more. 0.25: keeper seated, lid shut: point under the lock block within 10 mm of the magnet centre, at most 3 mm up, tilt under 5 degrees. 0: none, or a dropped part at any moment, which voids the run for good (keeper or pack 5 cm below the table, or pack falling over 0.4 m/s faster than the hand holding it, whether released, slipping or tumbling; real trial: the pack falls freely more than about 1 cm at any moment, judged from the side video). Real trial: the 3 mm lift is read against a steel rule stood upright beside the lock end in the side phone's frame, the 5 degree tilt from the side phone, the rest from the top phone; steel rule with tick marks 10 mm either side of the magnet centre, side-view and top-view phone video, protractor card, taped bagging area.
run_limit: 2,400 steps (120 s at 20 Hz), about 3.4 times the 35 s demo
reset_notes: Nothing is random. Put the pack back in the keeper on its mark, shut the lid until it locks, and set the keeper on its mark, its lock end 3 cm left of the magnet; about 20 seconds (estimate), nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Approximate: a rigid keeper (base and clear lid on a revolute hinge, 0.12 N m friction) and a rigid 80 g pack. The lock is code on the lid joint: held up to 6.0 N m (40 N at the lip) off the magnet, a 0.75 N m catch (5 N) while seated, free past 8 degrees. Magnet pull not modelled. Detacher face and bagging area are flush, no collider. Catch, lock, lip, wall and seating window are estimates, each run across a stated range. The demo reads the pack's pose.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; demo: 1.0 (both hands, 709 steps); one hand only: 0.0; keeper off the magnet, both hands on the lid: 0.0; no action: 0.0; pack let go in the air: 0.0; pack slipping from a loosened grip: 0.0; pack lowered fast while held: 1.0.
